map.迁移量(mg/dm²) = 模拟液中物质浓度×体积 / 接触面积 ÷1000；按: Migration (mg/dm²) = substance concentration in the simulant × volume / contact area ÷ 1000; convert to mg/kg of food by multiplying by 6, taking 6 dm²/kg.
Simulant concentration 0.5 mg/L, volume 200 mL, area 3 dm², SML 1.5 mg/kg: migration 0.5 × 200/3/1000 ≈ 0.033 mg/dm² or 0.20 mg/kg, far below the SML of 1.5, so it passes.
